name: The Domino

perks.name: Arrowhead Brake
perks.desc:
Lightly vented barrel.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Chambered Compensator
perks.desc:
Stable barrel attachment.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Corkscrew Rifling
perks.desc:
Balanced barrel. 
  •  Slightly increases range and stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Extended Barrel
perks.desc:
Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.desc:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Full Bore
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for distance.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Hammer-Forged Rifling
perks.desc:
Durable ranged barrel.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Full Choke
perks.desc: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Appended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon's magazine is built for higher capacity.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Tactical Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has multiple tactical improvements.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases magazine size

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Steady Rounds
perks.desc:
This magazine is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Greatly increases stability 
  •  Slightly decreases range
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Alloy Magazine
perks.desc: Faster reload when the magazine is nearly empty.

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.desc:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Ricochet Rounds
perks.desc:
Rounds ricochet off hard surfaces. 
  •  Increases stability 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Light Mag
perks.desc:
Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Armor-Piercing Rounds
perks.desc:
Rounds cause extra damage to combatants' shields and overpenetrate targets. 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Drop Mag
perks.desc: Increases reload speed but reduces magazine size.

perks.name: Assault Mag
perks.desc:
This shotgun's magazine is optimized for quick combat.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases rate of fire

perks.name: High-Caliber Rounds
perks.desc:
Shots from this weapon knock the target back farther.
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.desc: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Slideways
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts handling and stability.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.desc: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Shot Swap
perks.desc: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at a faster rate.

perks.name: Overflow
perks.desc: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo automatically loads this weapon beyond normal capacity.

perks.name: Pulse Monitor
perks.desc: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Mulligan
perks.desc: Missing a shot has a chance to return ammo directly to the magazine.

perks.name: Multikill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading grants increased damage based on the number of rapid final blows made beforehand.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Nadir Focus
perks.desc: Sustained fire increases accuracy and range. Increases lunge distance for Swords, and projectile velocity for Launchers.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Future War Cult will always be the best cult, don’t even @ me. New Monarchy? Not a cult. Dead Orbit? Also not a cult. It’s literally in the name. Jokes aside, the Domino has some interesting but not meta shaking perks. Overflow and Subsistence will probably be what everyone gravitates towards while Shoot to Loot will be a more niche option. Incandescent is the only good perk in the fourth column with Harmony offering some niche but good damage alternatives." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "The Domino has better perks for PvP but even then the best perk in the third column is Slideways, not even Slideshot or Snapshot Sights, Slideways. Opening Shot and Moving Target are both great for making sure you can hit headshots and Incandescent allows for some nice AoE damage but I think outside of people investing into this sniper it will not see much use." Recommended MW: Handling.
